prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: wide background artwork for the itch.io storefront page of ABYSS, a dark fantasy ASCII dungeon crawler. Generate a landscape 1920x1080 image. This is a backdrop behind website content, NOT a cover, poster or screenshot.
Scene: ancient underground dungeon ruins descending into darkness, weathered stone arches, fragmented columns, tiny distant amber embers and a suggestion of stairs. Put the architectural detail mostly on the far left and far right edges and subtly along the bottom. The central 65 percent of the image must be extremely dark, nearly black and visually quiet, with no focal subject, so a website content panel and text remain readable. No bright elements in the center. Edge imagery should gently dissolve into darkness at the top and bottom, allowing a dark page background to continue beyond the image.
Style: all visible architecture and light constructed from crisp colored monospace ASCII glyphs (# + = / | _ . : *), densely arranged into sophisticated textured character mosaics. Match a premium restrained dungeon aesthetic: black background, very dim desaturated teal stone outlines, sparse muted ivory glyph highlights, tiny amber accents. Much darker and lower contrast than a cover image; subtle atmospheric environment, not visual noise. Flat image filling the entire canvas, no frame or mockup.
No title, no words, no logos, no watermark, no interface, no hero character. No photorealism, no painted surfaces, no neon colors. Prioritize readability of content layered over it and balanced peripheral detail.
